implementationNotes: Use this file as structured CONTENT INPUT, not as a mandate to create 24 new routes; inspect existing routes and merge by project slug/name.
Project cards and review cards should be separated from existing core portfolio data only when needed. Reviews must retain verified project mapping, rating, job title, and quote.
Only render written review cards for reviews with hasWrittenReview=true. Rating-only contracts may be shown as evidence in project pages, but not as quotes.
Do not use screenshot source filenames as portfolio artwork. Project visuals must come from authentic existing assets or fetched, permission-cleared links.
Google Drive sharing pages are external source/reference links, not direct image/video URLs; do not embed a drive open URL in an image/video src.
LocalMediaFilename entries represent filenames cited by the author, not actual uploaded files.
Keep the existing homepage theme, project routes, section ordering and carousel UI consistent.
Reviews must be swipeable/arrow navigable with overflow-snap, keyboard navigation, and reduced motion behavior; autoplay disabled.
If a project already exists, enrich it in place; never create duplicates. Add new case studies only with verified titles, assets, and route availability.
Audit a few screenshot transcriptions against source if exact punctuation is critical. No client name is inferred from contract title.
Risky category: Zaffiri Precision involves regulated firearm components. Avoid technical instruction on manufacturing; present only non-actionable visual design scope.
